lines.text: Two nights later, the animals came.
They came out of the north like a white flood. Wolves, elk, frost-bears. Not hunting. Fleeing. And the Measurers' camp was right in their path.
They're outside the wall, my lord! If we open that gate, they'll see everything. Every ring we've hidden.
Tobin swung his hammer. Granny swung her axe. And two little girls carried a grown Measurer to safety between them, like a sack of turnips.
Then I saw Hask. Down in the snow, his lens cracked, and a frost-bear rising over him.
I can't fight. I've never been able to fight. I ran at it anyway.
We leave for two weeks, and you start a war?
By dawn it was over. And eleven Measurers had seen exactly what the people of Greyhollow were.
The Lord Who Measured Zero. Chapter 27, coming soon.
